question: The Third Battle of Panipat in 1761 was fought between Ahmad Shah Abdali and which Indian power?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Marathas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Third Battle of Panipat** was fought on **14 January 1761**, marking one of the largest and bloodiest battles in Indian history.
 
• The battle took place between **Ahmad Shah Abdali** (also known as Ahmad Shah Durrani), the founder of the **Durrani Empire**, and the **Marathas**, who were the dominant Indian power at the time.
